### Release Notes

<details>
<summary>spf13/pflag (github.com/spf13/pflag)</summary>

### [`v1.1.0`](https://redirect.github.com/spf13/pflag/releases/tag/v1.1.0)

[Compare Source](https://redirect.github.com/spf13/pflag/compare/v1.0.10...v1.1.0)

It's been long enough, and enough things have been fixed, that it might be time to release a new version, even if there isn't any particular big new issue to market as the reason for this release.

If you notice anything breaking, it is entirely un-intentional, but you might also have been relying on [undocumented](https://www.hyrumslaw.com/) or [buggy](https://xkcd.com/1172/) behavior. Please file an issue describing what you're doing, how it worked before this release and why it doesn't work anymore, and pin your projects to `v1.0.10` (the latest release before this one) while we decide how to address your concerns.

#### What's Changed

- README: update badges and minor linting fixes by [@​thaJeztah](https://redirect.github.com/thaJeztah) in [#​452](https://redirect.github.com/spf13/pflag/pull/452)
- Show 'correct' explicit bool value syntax in help by [@​alimpfard](https://redirect.github.com/alimpfard) in [#​453](https://redirect.github.com/spf13/pflag/pull/453)
- Fix for Go 1.24 by [@​pterjan](https://redirect.github.com/pterjan) in [#​460](https://redirect.github.com/spf13/pflag/pull/460)
- fix(map): ensure string-to-string flags maintain stable pointers by [@​brandon1024](https://redirect.github.com/brandon1024) in [#​457](https://redirect.github.com/spf13/pflag/pull/457)
- Fix getFlagType error message by [@​wellitonscheer](https://redirect.github.com/wellitonscheer) in [#​462](https://redirect.github.com/spf13/pflag/pull/462)
- update actions, and fix linting issues by [@​thaJeztah](https://redirect.github.com/thaJeztah) in [#​450](https://redirect.github.com/spf13/pflag/pull/450)
- fix: README.md indicating the use of godoc(deprecated) by [@​malklera](https://redirect.github.com/malklera) in [#​467](https://redirect.github.com/spf13/pflag/pull/467)
- Fix broken link to POSIX argument conventions by [@​tomasaschan](https://redirect.github.com/tomasaschan) in [#​464](https://redirect.github.com/spf13/pflag/pull/464)
- Replace raw stdlib parse errors in typed flag Set methods ([#​269](https://redirect.github.com/spf13/pflag/issues/269)) by [@​reuvenharrison](https://redirect.github.com/reuvenharrison) in [#​469](https://redirect.github.com/spf13/pflag/pull/469)
- Extend `UnknownFlags` to `UnknownFlagsHandling` and introduce `PassUnknownFlagToArgs` ([#​337](https://redirect.github.com/spf13/pflag/issues/337)) by [@​ikedam](https://redirect.github.com/ikedam) in [#​440](https://redirect.github.com/spf13/pflag/pull/440)
- fix: allow nil default IP flags in GetIP by [@​happysnaker](https://redirect.github.com/happysnaker) in [#​483](https://redirect.github.com/spf13/pflag/pull/483)
- fix: allow hex input in UintSlice by [@​happysnaker](https://redirect.github.com/happysnaker) in [#​484](https://redirect.github.com/spf13/pflag/pull/484)
- fix: honor custom IsBoolFlag compatibility by [@​happysnaker](https://redirect.github.com/happysnaker) in [#​487](https://redirect.github.com/spf13/pflag/pull/487)
- docs: clarify SortFlags example with complete runnable program by [@​happysnaker](https://redirect.github.com/happysnaker) in [#​488](https://redirect.github.com/spf13/pflag/pull/488)
- docs: add release process documentation by [@​happysnaker](https://redirect.github.com/happysnaker) in [#​490](https://redirect.github.com/spf13/pflag/pull/490)
- fix: print to set destination, not hardcoded os.Stderr by [@​quite](https://redirect.github.com/quite) in [#​502](https://redirect.github.com/spf13/pflag/pull/502)
- ci: bump golangci-lint to v2.13 for Go 1.27 by [@​hdimer](https://redirect.github.com/hdimer) in [#​508](https://redirect.github.com/spf13/pflag/pull/508)
- Initialize the target map when a StringToString flag has a nil default by [@​nikolauspschuetz](https://redirect.github.com/nikolauspschuetz) in [#​506](https://redirect.github.com/spf13/pflag/pull/506)
- fix: honour deprecated ParseErrorsWhitelist.UnknownFlagsHandling by [@​lenamonj](https://redirect.github.com/lenamonj) in [#​507](https://redirect.github.com/spf13/pflag/pull/507)
- test: add StringSlice Append coverage by [@​LY-19418](https://redirect.github.com/LY-19418) in [#​504](https://redirect.github.com/spf13/pflag/pull/504)
- Keep wrapping after an unbreakable usage word by [@​AzazelSensei](https://redirect.github.com/AzazelSensei) in [#​503](https://redirect.github.com/spf13/pflag/pull/503)
- Validate IP slice values before appending or replacing by [@​agammann](https://redirect.github.com/agammann) in [#​513](https://redirect.github.com/spf13/pflag/pull/513)
- fix(ci): Use the latest golangci-lint release by [@​tomasaschan](https://redirect.github.com/tomasaschan) in [#​525](https://redirect.github.com/spf13/pflag/pull/525)
- Reject IPv6 addresses as IPv4 masks by [@​yuefdev](https://redirect.github.com/yuefdev) in [#​524](https://redirect.github.com/spf13/pflag/pull/524)
- Report the flag name as typed in deprecation warnings by [@​hdimer](https://redirect.github.com/hdimer) in [#​500](https://redirect.github.com/spf13/pflag/pull/500)
- Document non-interspersed argument parsing by [@​yuefdev](https://redirect.github.com/yuefdev) in [#​523](https://redirect.github.com/spf13/pflag/pull/523)
- Preserve trailing whitespace in StringToString formatting by [@​r4venrudy](https://redirect.github.com/r4venrudy) in [#​522](https://redirect.github.com/spf13/pflag/pull/522)
- Reject extra CSV records in StringToString arguments by [@​Harshil-1603](https://redirect.github.com/Harshil-1603) in [#​521](https://redirect.github.com/spf13/pflag/pull/521)
- Preserve current string values in CopyToGoFlagSet by [@​adenzhou1350](https://redirect.github.com/adenzhou1350) in [#​520](https://redirect.github.com/spf13/pflag/pull/520)
- Fix type identification and mismatch checks for text flags by [@​dewanshshekhar](https://redirect.github.com/dewanshshekhar) in [#​526](https://redirect.github.com/spf13/pflag/pull/526)
- fix: enforce native integer flag bounds on 32-bit platforms by [@​gdpu11](https://redirect.github.com/gdpu11) in [#​534](https://redirect.github.com/spf13/pflag/pull/534)
- fix: preserve count flag values when parsing fails by [@​gdpu11](https://redirect.github.com/gdpu11) in [#​533](https://redirect.github.com/spf13/pflag/pull/533)
